title: Small business pays bills with Online Bill Pay (ACH/debit/credit card funded) and syncs QuickBooks
customer_goal: Pay vendor invoices and track them

governance.access_policy: Public-source competitive intelligence; legal review before external sharing

moments.customer_action: 'Pay business bills': pay by ACH, debit or credit card; track invoices and payments; connect QuickBooks Online; schedule multiple payments at once
moments.action: 'Pay business bills': pay by ACH, debit or credit card; track invoices and payments; connect QuickBooks Online; schedule multiple payments at once

touchpoints.screen: Capital One Business account > 'Payments & expenses' tab > enroll in 'Accounts Payable' > 'Manage Accounts Payable' (bill pay dashboard); marketed as 'Accounts Payable with Capital One' / 'Pay Vendors'

moments.frontstage: Free only for select methods (ACH); not credit card

moments.title: Enter invoice and vendor info (manually, by uploading an invoice, or by…
moments.customer_action: Enter invoice and vendor info (manually, by uploading an invoice, or by syncing accounting software) > 'Pay your way': select the funding source (Capital One Business card, any bank account or debit card) and the vendor's delivery method (single-use virtual card emailed to the vendor, ACH 'bank transfer delivery', or paper check); schedule multiple bill payments at once
moments.action: Enter invoice and vendor info (manually, by uploading an invoice, or by syncing accounting software) > 'Pay your way': select the funding source (Capital One Business card, any bank account or debit card) and the vendor's delivery method (single-use virtual card emailed to the vendor, ACH 'bank transfer delivery', or paper check); schedule multiple bill payments at once

touchpoints.screen: Manage Accounts Payable > bill pay dashboard > add vendor/invoice > Pay

moments.frontstage: Fee applied by funding/delivery combination: card-funded virtual card 0%; bank-account-funded ACH or check 0%; card- or debit-card-funded ACH or check 2.9% processing fee. Virtual cards 'can only be used once for the exact amount sent'. Payments tracked from the dashboard; QuickBooks Online sync.

touchpoints.screen: Accounts Payable help line 1-800-867-0904; SBB voice team 1-888-755-2172 (8am–11pm ET M–F); business banker; no SMB help-center article exists for bill pay

assessment: Card-funded vendor pay plus QuickBooks sync suggests an embedded third-party AP platform; vendor and flow not disclosed.

terms.fees: Free for ACH; card-funded payments carry a fee (amount undisclosed)
